# Clay documentation index

Clay is a Rust application layer over GPUI. Linux is the only runtime-verified
platform. Clay package version: 0.3.0.

## For application-building agents

- [AI guide index](docs/ai/README.md)
- [Application setup](docs/ai/getting-started.md)
- [Public API reference](docs/ai/api-reference.md)
- [Components and layout](docs/ai/component-guide.md)
- [State, events, and tasks](docs/ai/state-and-events.md)
- [Native services](docs/ai/native-services.md)
- [Recipes](docs/ai/recipes.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/ai/troubleshooting.md)
- [Limitations](docs/ai/limitations.md)

## Compilable reference applications

- [Settings application](examples/settings-app/)
- [System monitor](examples/system-monitor/)
- [Minimal project template](templates/minimal/)

## For framework contributors

- [Canonical agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [Human contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md)
- [Repository README](README.md)

If an example and this index disagree with the installed crate, inspect the
installed source and lockfile for the actual version before using an API.
